This role is highly operational, cross-functional, and collaborative, acting as a key interface between local agencies, internal teams, and Global HQ.

Who We Are

Founded in 2010, Novibet is an established GameTech company operating in Europe, the Americas, and ROW countries (Greece, Brazil, Ireland, Finland, Mexico, Chile, Ecuador, Cyprus, and New Zealand), with hubs in Greece, Malta, Brazil, and Mexico and 1200+ employees across all countries of operation. We are committed to staying at the forefront of technological advancements, continually pushing boundaries and delivering seamless entertainment and online gaming experiences to our rapidly expanding customer base.

Why Novibet

At Novibet, you are empowered to excel, prioritizing growth through listening and learning as part of a group of forward-thinkers and doers continuously adapting to new challenges. We are equally committed to fostering a positive, inclusive, and supportive workplace culture that empowers every individual to thrive.

Join us, and you will be part of a team of over 1,200 people worldwide that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

What you will work on

Media Planning & Execution

• Support the execution of the monthly and quarterly media plans across ATL (TV, CTV, OOH, radio)

• Coordinate campaign setups, timelines, and deliveries with media agencies and partners.

• Ensure media plans are executed according to approved budget envelopes, KPIs, and timelines.

• Assist with the rollout of quarterly media commitments and tactical optimizations.

Media Operations & Performance

• Track campaign delivery, pacing, and performance across channels.

• Consolidate media results, reports, and post-campaign analyses.

• Support optimization discussions with agencies based on performance insights.

• Maintain organized media documentation (plans, proposals, contracts, reports).

Agency & Partner Management

• Act as a day-to-day contact for media agencies and selected partners.

• Collect proposals, ensure alignment with briefs, and support internal evaluations.

• Coordinate material deadlines, approvals, and trafficking with agencies and internal stakeholders.

Internal Collaboration & HQ Interface

• Work closely with the Marketing Media & Comms Manager to ensure alignment between local execution and global strategy.

• Support communication with Global HQ, ensuring clarity, accuracy, and timely delivery of media-related information and reports.

• Participate in alignment meetings and preparation of materials for HQ and senior stakeholders.

What you bring

• At least 2 years of experience in media coordination, media planning, or media operations.

• Solid understanding of traditional media (especially TV) and off-media initiatives.

• Experience working with media agencies

• Strong organizational and project management skills.

• Data-driven mindset with the ability to interpret media KPIs and reports.

• Advanced English (spoken and written) - mandatory for daily interaction with Global HQ.

• Proficiency in Excel/Sheets and presentation tools (PowerPoint/Google Slides).

Nice to have (PLUSES)

• Genuine interest in sports and live events, especially football.

• Previous experience in regional or global matrix organizations.

• Familiarity with performance-oriented environments and fast decision cycles.

title: Retail Credit Risk Specialist Brazil, Sao Paulo
description:
About Us

Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 122 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page

About the team

The Credit Risk Squad is part of the 2nd line of Defense, responsible for managing and overseeing the credit risk function of our organization by providing independent oversight and challenge to the first line of defense. As a second line Credit Risk team, we are responsible for creating Expected Credit Losses (ECL) models that are used to calculate loss allowances, making sure the company’s credit risk is managed correctly and efficiently, participating end‑to‑end in the model development process, including, implementation, monitoring, ensuring operational quality of the data and supporting Finance accounting teams.

About the Role

As a Credit Risk Specialist within our Credit Risk Squad (part of the 2nd Line of Defense), you will play a crucial role in supporting Nubank’s world class risk management framework. Your primary focus will be on expected credit loss models development and maintenance, particularly within the retail market portfolios, including credit cards and personal loans. You will contribute significantly to ensuring the company’s credit risk is managed effectively, with a strong emphasis on the universe of credit provisions.

Your key responsibilities will include

  • Developing, implementing, analysing and monitoring risk parameter models (PD, LGD, EAD) relevant to our retail portfolios, ensuring they align with regulations like IFRS9 and 4966. You will be instrumental in making sure we have state of the art models also through activities such as backtesting, data analysis, documentation and operational monitoring.
  • Maintaining a strong understanding of relevant local and international regulations concerning provisions and credit risk management, including a surface-level understanding of standards like Bacen 4966 and IFRS9.
  • Performing in‑depth analysis of credit risk exposure and its implications for expected credit losses (ECL) and loss allowances. This will involve understanding how changes in the credit portfolio impact our provisions.
  • Participating in monthly accounting closing activities, contributing to the creation of reports on loss allowance movements.
  • Actively contributing to the enhancement of our controls environment within credit risk management. This is crucial for ensuring compliance with regulations such as SOX.
  • Liaising with Internal and External Audit teams during model validation processes, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements and SOX compliance in our operational processes.
  • Leveraging your analytical and problem‑solving skills to manipulate and learn from data related to the credit portfolio.
  • This role requires a strong analytical background, a keen understanding of credit risk principles, and the ability to contribute to a robust and compliant credit risk management framework. Your work will directly impact the accuracy of our financial reporting and the overall stability of our credit operations.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Math, Statistics, Physics or related fields.
  • Analytical, problem solving and passionate to manipulate data in order to learn from it.
  • Great coding skills (SQL, Python, Scala or other similar programming languages).
  • Experience in developing or analysing outputs of Expected Credit Loss models/PD/EAD/LGD for credit provisioning purposes.
  • Adaptability to dynamic way of working/short term deliverables.

Preferred qualifications

  • Advanced or Fluent English.
  • Experience with SOX controls within risk management environment.

title: Product Development Engineer - Core & Clamping & Structural Analysis
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day

As a Product Development Engineer for Power Transformers – core & clamping design, you are a major part of the power transformers development group. Within a global development team, you are responsible for defining and supporting technical rules and solutions. You ensure that we define and implement uniform and standardized components, enabling new sustainable engineering solutions in a timely manner while keeping costs to a minimum. You will be involved in different R&D projects within the Product Management organization and support power transformer factories worldwide.

How You’ll Make An Impact

  • Collaborate within a global R&D and factory network to drive innovation and support regional demands.
  • Promote standardization and modularization programs while developing, improving, and implementing transformer design rules for specific applications.
  • Assist regional factory sites and engineering teams with technical expertise and operational support.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering (preferred) and correlated areas
  • Working experience as a power transformer design engineer for Core & Clamping. Experience in windings and/or winding assembly design is a plus.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience in Core & Clamping design (3D models, drawings and bill of materials).
  • Mechanical structural calculation of metallic structures. Experience with FEM calculation tools (ANSYS, CREO Simulate, others) is a plus.
  • Strong analytical skills with a systematic approach to complex problem-solving
  • Excellent teamwork and collaboration skills

About The Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.

As part of this Development team, you’ll be responsible for supporting the design, development, and continuous improvement of innovative solutions for power transformers. The team works in close collaboration with global engineering, manufacturing, quality, and project execution units, ensuring that our products meet the highest standards of performance, reliability, and compliance with international regulations. We foster a culture of technical excellence, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning, where engineers are encouraged to take ownership, propose improvements, and contribute actively to the evolution of our technologies. By joining this team, you will have the opportunity to grow technically and professionally, take ownership of meaningful engineering challenges, and see your work translated into products that operate in critical infrastructure around the world.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy:

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

  • Career growth and development opportunities
  • Supportive work culture
  • Company paid Health and wellness benefits
  • Paid Time Off and paid holidays
  • Profit Sharing Program
  • Private Pension
  • Parental Leave

Please attach your resume in English.

About the team

Our support team provides best‑in‑class service and support to our growing commercial customer base while meeting or exceeding our service level agreements as defined by our business requirements. About the role

We’re looking for a technical product support professional who is passionate about helping commercial customers get the most out of industry‑leading autonomous UAS drone investments. You’ll utilize your proven B2B customer support skills and capabilities to assist Skydio pilots and drone operators in understanding product features, troubleshooting software, hardware, and cloud issues, and recommending best practices for safely and effectively flying. When our customers need help, you are responsible and empowered via knowledge guides and flight diagnostic tools. You will have access to cross‑team experts to resolve their issues thoroughly, with an added emphasis on capturing data to inform product, process, and service improvement.

Working hours

Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:00 PM PT, with flexibility to work a weekend shift (Saturday & Sunday, 10‑hour shifts).

Location Preference

The ideal candidate will be located on the West Coast or within the Pacific Time Zone to align with working hours. This role may require up to 10% travel to regional customer sites.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Deliver premier technical support to drive customer satisfaction and brand evangelism
  • Know Skydio drone, controller, and cloud products inside and out, and proactively seek clarity on areas of ambiguity negatively impacting our customers
  • Be the Voice of Customer frontline to other Skydio teams that enable continuous product improvement based on customer needs
  • Use clear and empathetic written and verbal communication to quickly resolve issues that limit UAS fleet utilization and thereby drive high‑brand affinity over time
  • Over time, become a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in one or more aspects of the Skydio UAS platform and share your knowledge freely with other team members to create high‑trust team relationships
  • Engage in regular pre‑released product dogfooding and give feedback that helps deliver the highest quality product experience possible
  • Proactively participate in building support processes that improve and enhance the customer experience
  • Own your work and contribute to operational excellence and low‑effort customer support experiences

What makes you a good fit

  • 5-7 years of Technical Support experience with drones/UAV/UAS
  • Must have previous customer support experience in utilities, transportation/infrastructure, or public safety organizations
  • Willing to work a flexible schedule within a 10 to 7 hours of operations
  • Collaborate effectively with team members to resolve complex technical issues, actively share knowledge and expertise, and contribute to a supportive team environment.
  • Motivated self‑starter with impeccable verbal and written communication skills, obsessive attention to detail, and the ability to manage time effectively
  • Proficient in technical troubleshooting, problem‑solving and familiar with triage and escalation workflows
  • An inquisitive troubleshooter with a passion for drone, cloud, and IoT technology along with a strong desire to learn new skills and grow with Skydio
  • Experience with multi‑channel customer communication (phone, chat, email support)
  • CRM technology experience, Zendesk or Salesforce Service Cloud preferred
  • Prior support experience within a 360 customer success retention & renewal team is a plus
  • A strong desire for feedback to learn, grow, and perform duties more efficiently

*Compensation for certain positions may vary based on the position’s location.

Compensation

At Skydio, our compensation packages for regular, full‑time employees include competitive base salaries, equity in the form of stock options, and comprehensive benefits packages. Compensation will vary based on factors, including skill level, proficiencies, transferable knowledge, and experience. Relocation assistance may also be provided for eligible roles. The annual base salary range for this position is $59,600 - $100,000. Fundamentally, we believe that equity is the key to long‑term financial growth, and we ensure all regular, full‑time employees have the opportunity to significantly benefit from the company’s success. Regular, full‑time employees are eligible to enroll in the Company’s group health insurance plans. Regular, full‑time employees are eligible to receive the following benefits: Paid vacation time, sick leave, holiday pay and 401K savings plan. This position and all associated benefits are subject to applicable federal, state, and local laws, as well as the Company’s policies and eligibility criteria.

description:
Faça parte do nosso time e conte com a força da CVC Viagens, marca consolidada no mercado nacional de turismo e franquias, pra realizar o seu sonho e de milhões de brasileiros.

Somos a maior operadora de turismo do Brasil, existimos para criar, em cada viagem, histórias pra vida toda. Mais do que vender viagens, ajudamos as pessoas a realizarem seus sonhos!

Se você é uma pessoa apaixonada por viagens, tem bons conhecimentos de geografia e gosta de trabalhar orientado pelo propósito de realizar o sonho de viagem dos clientes, essa é a oportunidade para carimbar seu passaporte! ✈️

**O programa Passaporte Franquias não visa preencher vagas diretas na CVC Corp, mas sim exclusivamente eventuais vagas disponíveis em uma das lojas franqueadas CVC Viagens em todo o Brasil. Assim, uma vez cadastrado seu currículo poderá ser consultado por toda a rede de franquias e por outras empresas do grupo CVC.**

Responsabilidades

  • Prestar atendimento aos clientes no pré e pós-venda, a fim de garantir satisfação.
  • Prestar atendimento aos clientes por diversos canais (telefone, Whatsapp, mídias sociais e pessoalmente, na loja).
  • Pesquisar, entender e personalizar viagem do cliente (seja para orçamento ou venda), informando produtos e promoções do período.
  • Acompanhar os desafios de metas de vendas do mês, conforme orientação do líder imediato.
  • Proceder à confirmação do embarque do cliente, apresentando relação de documentação necessária, posicionando sobre os riscos de embarque sem a devida documentação, solicitando ciência ao mesmo, orientando sobre disponibilidades de materiais para a viagem, tais como vouchers, passagens, entre outros, com o objetivo de finalizar o processo com sucesso.
  • Desenvolver o processo de reservas no sistema informatizado integrado, realizando as devidas reservas conforme solicitação do cliente, com o objetivo de garantir a vaga no destino evitando a perda da venda.
  • Efetuar o acompanhamento do cliente pós-venda até o termino da viagem, confirmando os serviços contratados, efetuando a entrega dos vouchers/passagens, a fim de auxiliar em caso de dúvidas ou outras necessidades.
  • Utilizar de forma correta as ferramentas disponibilizadas pela CVC, para evitar erros.
  • Realizar de forma frequente os treinamentos disponibilizados pela CVC.

Qualificações

  • Experiência em vendas em qualquer segmento
  • Ensino médio completo (maior de 18 anos) ou graduação (completa ou incompleta) preferencialmente em Turismo, Administração ou área afins.
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita e empatia
  • Familiaridade com redes sociais par atendimento ao cliente também via mensagens
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em horário do comércio, em lojas de shopping ou de rua
  • Desejável noções de finanças/matemática (Excel e Porcentagem).
  • Conhecimentos gerais de geografia
  • Vontade de aprender em capacitações gratuitas para acelerar seu aprendizado em turismo;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar em escala 6x1.

Benefícios

  • Vale refeição;
  • Jornada de treinamento;

Diversidade e respeito são a nossa bandeira e todas as pessoas são bem-vindas!

Com mais de 50 anos de história, período em que realizamos os sonhos de viagens de milhares de brasileiros, nós da CVC Viagens também apoiamos a geração de empregos e oportunidades de carreira aos brasileiros, nos mais de 500 municípios do Brasil onde as Lojas Franqueadas CVC estão presentes.

Assim nasce o Programa Passaporte Franquia, que aproxima as pessoas com mais de 18 anos das oportunidades de vagas de emprego nas lojas franqueadas da maior rede de viagens do Brasil. A maioria das vagas é para Consultores (as) de Vendas e é muito simples participar: basta escolher a vaga abaixo de seu interesse e cadastrar o seu currículo.

A partir de sua candidatura, o franqueado responsável pela vaga passa então a ter acesso ao seu currículo, aplicado para a vaga escolhida, podendo agendar entrevistas diretamente com os candidatos, de forma imediata ou futura (conforme oferta de vagas na região).

Dando o "match", ou seja, o franqueado aprovando o candidato após etapa de seleção e entrevista, o mesmo informará data de início da jornada e detalhes da contratação. Você pode se candidatar em quantas vagas desejar, em diferentes localidades!

Médico Pediatra - Vaga Afirmativa para Pessoa com Deficiência

Workplace: São Paulo - SP São Paulo - SP

Somos mais de 12 mil colaboradores e convivemos em uma instituição que valoriza o trabalhador e a diversidade. Ética, respeito e excelência na gestão fazem parte da missão do Seconci-SP. Temos como princípio oferecer um atendimento humanizado e de qualidade, pois trabalhamos com um bem extremamente precioso: a Saúde.

Venha trabalhar conosco e fazer parte de uma equipe que tem o compromisso de salvar vidas e construir o Brasil.

  • Desempenhar suas atividades, respeitando os princípios do Código de Ética Médica e cumprir as normas de trabalho;
  • Prestar atendimento aos pacientes/usuários de acordo com a demanda de atendimentos, efetuando a história clínica, exame físico e hipótese diagnóstica, realizando os procedimentos, encaminhando o paciente/usuário a exames complementares quando necessário, iniciando tratamento específico ou encaminhando-o para outra especialidade;
  • Interpretar dados de exames clínicos e exames complementares;
  • Diagnosticar estado de saúde de pacientes / usuários;
  • Comunicar o usuário sobre modificações importantes no quadro evolutivo do mesmo, bem como registrar em prontuário; 7. Prestar informações médicas aos usuários, acompanhantes, familiares, responsáveis ou cuidadores, de acordo com sua capacidade de compreensão, quando solicitado e/ou necessário, em conformidade com orientação do médico assistente;
  • Efetuar o planejamento das admissões e altas em conjunto com a equipe multiprofissional e supervisionar os cuidados clínicos efetuados na unidade;
  • Registrar fluxo de atendimento em relatórios e prontuários;
  • Prescrever medicações específicas, bem como fornecer atestados médicos e comprovantes de comparecimento.
  • Superior completo em Medicina,
  • Residência/Especialização em pediatria.
  • Horário: Terças feiras das 08:00 às 19:00
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Vale Refeição
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo
  • Atendimento Ambulatorial e Odontológico - SP
  • Incentivo a Educação/Universidades

Conheça o Seconci-SP

O Seconci-SP - Serviço Social da Construção Civil do Estado de São Paulo é uma entidade filantrópica, sem fins lucrativos, fundada em março de 1964 por um grupo de empresários do setor para atender aos trabalhadores da construção e seus familiares. Com sede na capital, o Seconci-SP mantém outras 12 Unidades Ambulatoriais no Estado de São Paulo, que realizam at endimentos médico-ambulatoriais, odontológicos, exames, serviços complementares e de apoio.

GESTÃO INTEGRADA DE SAÚDE E SEGURANÇA DO TRABALHO

Além da assistência prestada ao trabalhador da construção civil, o Seconci-SP, há mais de 25 anos assessora empresas de todos os setores/segmentos na gestão integrada de Saúde e Segurança do Trabalho (SST).

Conta com profissionais experientes e altamente qualificados em sua equipe própria, formada por médicos do trabalho, engenheiros e técnicos de segurança, além de especialistas com notório reconhecimento no mercado.

Um outro importante diferencial: o Seconci-SP trabalha com o Sistema SOC, líder de mercado na área de gestão de SST.

O Seconci-SP auxilia as empresas na implantação e implementação de ações preventivas, visando a melhoria da qualidade de vida dos trabalhadores, o aumento da produtividade e a redução dos custos operacionais.

ORGANIZAÇÃO SOCIAL DE SAÚDE - OSS

Por sua grande experiência na atenção à saúde e por já atuar como parceiro do Estado de São Paulo, retirando das filas do SUS milhares de usuários, o Seconci-SP foi convidado em 1998, a participar de processo de qualificação da primeira geração de Organizações Sociais de Saúde (OSS) do País. Para assumir a gestão de equipamentos de saúde em parceria com o Estado e Munícipio de São Paulo.

Somos individuos plurais em um propósito singular. Somos todos Santa Casa. Desta forma, SOMOS é o nome atribuído ao programa de Diversidade e Inclusão da Santa Casa.

Nossa cultura do acolher, cuidar e conviver está presente em todos nossos hospitais: Hospital Santa Clara, Hospital São Francisco, Pavilhão Pereira Filho, Hospital São José, Hospital Santa Rita, Hospital Dom Vicente Scherer, Hospital da Criança Santo Antônio (em Porto Alegre) e Hospital Dom João Becker (em Gravataí/RS). Também integram a Santa Casa as unidades de Atenção Primária à Saúde (APS), Unidade Pronto Atendimento (UPA), Casa de Apoio Madre Ana , o Centro Histórico-Cultural e o Cemitério Santa Casa .

A Santa Casa de Porto Alegre une tradição, inovação, história, cultura, ensino e pesquisa. Vamos juntos fazer a diferença na vida das pessoas?

WillowTree is seeking a proficient GenAI Engineer passionate about the technology, and ready to implement research concepts into tangible and production-ready solutions for our global clients. As a GenAI Engineer, you will be instrumental in applying and integrating generative AI models to enhance digital products, while also applying best coding, testing, and monitoring practices, making AI accessible and valuable in a real-world context.

  • Apply your knowledge of AI systems and software engineering to develop solutions that directly address and resolve business problems.

  • Navigate and manipulate generative AI models, including (but not limited to) LLMs, to create prompts and solutions tailored to specific use cases.

  • Understand and properly apply Responsible AI concepts in all the stages of the solution.
  • Lead the charge in designing, measuring, and evaluating AI model outputs, developing standard and custom metrics to ensure alignment with business objectives.

  • Drive the selection and application of appropriate evaluation metrics, ensuring that AI solutions are robust, unbiased, and meet all necessary performance standards.

  • Demonstrable experience in applied AI, with a foundation in machine learning, NLP, LLMs, and statistical analysis.
  • Strong understanding of the trade-offs between various generative AI models and the ability to choose the right model for specific use cases.
  • Experience with data embeddings and vector databases, understanding the trade-off between available options, and leveraging it to optimize data ingestion.
  • Experience in architecting and developing solutions that integrate generative AI with traditional software solutions with minimal to no oversight.
  • Experience building and testing a server-side platform for API development and orchestration.
  • Proficient in the Python language and understands the trade-offs between multiple frameworks and patterns.

  • Hands-on experience deploying software on leading cloud platforms and utilizing AI tools like AWS Bedrock, Azure AI Services, and Vertex AI.
  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to work alongside developers from multiple different areas.
  • Ability to communicate complex AI solutions and concepts effectively to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

title: Senior Media Partnerships Services Manager
description:
Senior Media Partnerships Services Manager

Department: Broadcast & Media Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil


Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.


THE POSITION

Reporting to the Head of Broadcast FIFA27 and Senior Partnerships Services Manager in Zurich HQ, the Senior Media Partnerships Services Manager FIFA27 will assume crucial responsibility in overseeing and facilitating the provision of services to FIFA’s Media Partners.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Oversee and coordinate the preparation of all aspects of services provided to FIFA’s Media Partners in the Host Country, excluding host broadcast production. This encompassing role includes accommodation, accreditation, catering, customs, filming permits, frequency licensing, logistics, transportation, venue access control, visas, work permits, site visits, and more.
  • Contribute hiring and supervising the Media Partnerships Services Manager. Coordinate an event team consisting of 4-6 skilled staff members based at different stadiums.
  • Maintain effective communication and work closely with the Zurich-based Relations and Services department.
  • Forge collaborative partnership with the Host Broadcast Production colleagues to determine and implement optimal unilateral services across all broadcast venues (Stadiums, International Broadcast Coordination Center, FIFA Fan Fests, and beyond).
  • Cultivate enduring relationships with key functional areas of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™, fostering synergies and ensuring smooth operation of essential services.
  • Work hand in hand with the Relations management team to address the specific needs of Media Partners during their visits to the Host Cities, providing comprehensive support throughout the preparation phase.
  • Support organising various workshops as well as venue tours.
  • Manage and coordinate services for numerous operations and milestone events leading up to the tournament, starting with the Draw in December 2026.
  • Contribute actively to the seamless delivery of services during the tournament, always ensuring the highest standards of excellence.

YOUR PROFILE

Education

  • Master’s degree or similar higher education in Business and/or Sports Management or equivalent education.

Experience

  • 5-7 years of experience in a similar role.
  • Experience in the Sports industry is an advantage.
  • Experience in Broadcast environment is an advantage.
  • Experience of working in Brazil and knowledge of local culture will be an added benefit.
  • Experience in major sports events, such as the FIFA World Cup ™ or other FIFA events will be an asset.

Skills & Competencies

  • ACCOUNTABILITY: We are looking for accountable individuals—people who take ownership of their responsibilities, follow through on commitments, and drive results with integrity. Individuals must be ready to step up, be reliable, and make a meaningful impact.
  • LEADERSHIP: We are seeking individuals with leadership qualities—those who inspire others, lead by example, and guide internal/external teams with confidence, empathy, and purpose to achieve set objectives under tight timelines.
  • INITIATIVE: We are seeking people with strong initiative—self-starters who take proactive steps, anticipate challenges, and go beyond what’s expected without waiting to be asked – who have the capacity to break new ground, look for unconventional solutions, and produce fresh ideas.
  • DECISION MAKING: We are seeking decisive individuals, with the ability to identify critical situations and swiftly make decisions, who take initiative and calculated risks, who explore alternative solutions, and react promptly to unforeseen circumstances.
  • INNOVATION: We are looking for innovative thinkers—individuals who challenge the status quo, bring fresh ideas, and find creative solutions to complex problems.
  • VISION: We are looking for visionary individuals—people who see the bigger picture, formulate strategic plans, think long-term, perceive the organization’s global environmental impact and help shape bold ideas into reality.
  • INCLUSIVITY: We seek individuals who love teamwork, actively listen, embrace diverse perspectives, and help build collaborative, respectful teams.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Fluent in English and (Brazilian) Portuguese. Any other language is a plus.
  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.) and online collaboration tools.
  • This position requires frequent travel to participate in meetings and venue tours.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil, empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

Join to apply for the Student Attraction and Admissions Counselor role at ITEC - Instituto de Tecnologia e Computação

Sobre a posição

O ITEC está formando sua primeira turma. Estamos em busca de um profissional capaz de identificar e selecionar os alunos de alto potencial que definirão o padrão de excelência do nosso instituto. Esta posição vai além do recrutamento tradicional; é um papel estratégico de embaixador do Instituto. Você será responsável por levar a visão do ITEC a diferentes regiões do Brasil em um roadshow, conectando-se com escolas, famílias e estudantes.

A função exige um perfil híbrido: alguém que tenha a energia para o trabalho de campo (visitas a escolas, feiras e conversas com famílias) e, ao mesmo tempo, a disciplina analítica para gerir o funil de admissões (CRM), garantindo que o processo seletivo seja eficiente, justo e baseado em dados.

Sobre o ITEC: O ITEC é um instituto de ensino superior inovador e sem fins lucrativos, dedicado a formar talentos em Computação, com excelência acadêmica internacional e compromisso social no Brasil. Nossa proposta combina rigor acadêmico, inovação tecnológica e impacto social, para ampliar o acesso de jovens de alto potencial a oportunidades transformadoras na área da tecnologia.

Se você acredita no poder transformador da educação e quer colocar sua capacidade de execução a serviço de uma missão maior, levar o ITEC até escolas, conectar talentos e mobilizar a próxima geração de líderes em tecnologia, queremos você conosco nessa jornada!

Principais responsabilidades

Relacionamento e Outreach (Campo)

  • Desenvolver e executar, de forma estratégica, o calendário de visitas para a construção e aprofundamento de relações institucionais com escolas públicas e privadas e outros parceiros educacionais.

  • Assegurar uma Candidate Experience de excelência, por meio de uma comunicação consistente, ágil, empática e transparente em todas as interações e fases do processo seletivo.

  • Monitorar indicadores de performance (KPIs) do funil de captação (taxas de conversão, origem dos inscritos, eficiência por canal).

Uma holding que direciona 7 negócios com operações independentes e complementares: JSL (JSLG3), Movida (MOVI3), Vamos (VAMO3), CS Brasil, Automob, Banco BBC Digital e CS Infra.

Em 1956, na cidade de Mogi das Cruzes (SP), o caminhoneiro e imigrante português Julio Simões deu início a uma história de muito trabalho e que resultaria em um dos maiores grupos empresariais do Brasil. Cultura e Valores, Modelo de Gestão único e compromisso com práticas de Governança promovem geração de valor de forma sustentável aos acionistas, colaboradores, fornecedores e todos públicos de relacionamento da Companhia. title: Technical Development Manager
description:
Overview

Want to join a frontrunner in renewable energy that is actively seeking early entry into new markets globally? Since the establishment in 2007, Scatec has acquired extensive knowledge and experience in developing, building and operating solar, wind and hydro power plants and storage solutions. Driven by our company values and competent global workforce, we aim to deliver competitive and sustainable renewable energy globally; protect our environment and improve quality of life through innovative integration of technology; and create shareholder value. We are present on four continents and are headquartered in Oslo, Norway.

Main purpose of position

Currently we are looking for an Technical Development Manager (TDM) for São Paulo, Brazil to be part of our global team working together towards our vision – Improving our future. As our TDM you go support the projects during the opportunity and development phase by managing the engineering, supply chain and project control resources and workstreams to deliver a consistent EPC Technical and Commercial offer to Business Development.

The TDM assesses the pre‑feasibility of the project thanks to his technical knowledge, which is mainly civil works and electrical related and manages front‑end engineering studies by using internal or external resources. The TDM delivers a cost competitive EPC budget considering the specific site conditions and grid interconnection solution(s) of the projects.

Main Responsibilities

  • Gather all useful information and inputs from Business Development Department and support them to prepare the deliverables for the different key project decisions gate.
  • Coordinate and plan Engineering, Supply Chain and Project control internal resources and workstreams to ensure smooth and efficient documentation delivery.
  • Responsible for overall technical workstreams in early phases of solar PV projects, including feasibility and front‑end engineering studies, site studies, PV and HV technical preliminary design and design specifications in contracts.
  • Lead the development of technical concepts and solutions of the projects, identifies optimal solutions from a technical, commercial and execution perspective at early stage including civil, mechanical, and electrical aspects of solar PV plants, interconnection and high‑voltage design, yield assessments, as well as assessment of other technologies (floating PV, hybrids, etc).
  • Ensure that the EPC budget is competitive and consistent with specific Technical Solutions, uncertainties, and risks of the projects.
  • Lead external and internal technical development processes and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to successfully lead the project to construction start.
  • Manage EPC deliverables in Request for Proposals (RFPs) and Tenders organized by the off‑takers.
  • Work in a core regional team consisting of a handful of project development and project finance resources to jointly ensure we reach the company’s ambitious growth targets.
  • Support the organization by co‑developing and updating the Operating System to streamline processes, ensure homogeneous quality of the deliverables and efficient delivery.

Qualifications And Competencies

  • Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering or equivalent technical university degree
  • 5–10 years of professional experience, preferably within renewable energy IPPs or EPC companies
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken) and in the local language
  • Proven experience in tender preparation and construction budget development
  • Solid experience supporting the business development phase of projects, with good understanding of power markets, especially renewable energy
  • Strong technical knowledge of renewable energy systems , including power generation, grid interconnection, and transmission
  • Experience managing and planning technical workstreams for large‑scale infrastructure or renewable energy projects
  • Hands‑on experience with Technical Due Diligence processes
  • Strong commercial mindset , with the ability to optimize project value through technical design and execution decisions
  • Good understanding of technical and commercial contract structures commonly used in the renewables industry
  • Multidisciplinary understanding of EPC projects
  • Experience in the construction phase and exposure to Operations & Maintenance (O&M) is a plus
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office , especially Excel and presentation tools

Personal characteristics

It is part of every employee’s terms of reference to contribute to Scatec's vision: Improving our Future and adhere to our company values which are:

  • Predictable : demonstrate clear communication and listening skills, share information in an open and honest way
  • Driving results: demonstrate determination, pro‑activeness, can prioritize and work independently
  • Changemaker: demonstrate entrepreneurship, can challenge, fast learner, take initiatives and adjust
  • Working together: demonstrate teamwork, shares responsibilities, can compromise, has a can‑do attitude

We offer

Scatec is an exciting, innovative and ambitious company operating in a growing industry. We offer a challenging and interesting position where you will be part of a flexible, diverse and truly international working environment consisting of highly competent and committed colleagues with a positive drive to make a difference. Scatec is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other basis protected by appropriate law. All hiring decisions are made based on merit, competence and business need. Applications will be processed on a continuous basis.

In a customer-facing environment, lead a cross-functional processing implementation project team of technical and non-technical electronic payment processing experts from both MasterCard and our customer.   • Act as central point of contact for customers and/or MasterCard customer representatives throughout processing implementation project end-to-end execution.

  • Provide training to CIS organization, other MasterCard organizations and the customer.

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Exact Sciences, Engineering or Business or equivalent work experience.

Knowledge / Experience

  • Seven to ten years of “Information Technology” system knowledge, with strong understanding of network technology, applications, and project management.
  • Strong payment transaction processing and industry business principles knowledge.
  • Strong understanding of MasterCard’s payment processing systems, formats and associated customer host interface testing services and principles.
  • Strong understanding of the 4 party model and the full transaction lifecycle for MasterCard brands.

Qualifications

  • Interact well with the customer, Sr. and Executive management.
  • Candidate must be fluent in Portuguese and English. Spanish would be a plus.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills with ability to leverage these skills in a teaching environment.
  • Strong project management skills.
  • Ability to lead matrix organizations and cross functional teams.

Work Conditions

Occasional domestic and international travel.

Corporate Security Responsibility

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices.
